subject: graph-based
source_sentence: This paper addresses these challenges with a graph-based Markov chain model that leverages rich Web-scale statistics from one or more large-scale extraction sources in order to achieve high accuracy.
title: Markov Chains for Robust Graph-based Commonsense Information Extraction
